findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Scope the AC-3 run_sync oracle so the 895c-downgrade case is counted only under a well-formed FIRST prompted response (or explicitly permit the sanctioned native-reject + prompted-repair sequence, i.e. 1 native run_sync + up to N+1 prompted run_sync), rather than a flat 'never a third'.
evidence: structured_run.py:120-137 native path is ONE run_sync that raises (grammar rejection) before returning output on the 895c branch
structured_run.py:157-163 the fallback PROMPTED path runs `agent.run_sync` inside `for _ in range(output_retries+1)` — up to N+1 times
structured_run.py:117-119 output_retries = OUTPUT_RETRIES(=2) clamped by structured_retry_limit, so N can be >=1 on the downgrade path
AC-3 asserts the oracle counts run_sync invocations 'never a third' but couples this to the downgrade without a well-formed-first-prompted-response qualifier
findings.finding: The AC-3 run_sync-counting oracle ('exactly two (native then prompted) on the 895c downgrade, never a third') can misfire on a legitimate path the plan's own retry model sanctions: the 895c native attempt is one run_sync that raises before returning, then control enters the PROMPTED bounded loop (structured_run.py:161 `for _ in range(output_retries+1)`), which is allowed up to N+1 run_sync calls. If the downgraded prompted response legitimately needs one in-Agent output-repair retry (N>=1, i.e. structured_retry_limit not zero), that is a THIRD run_sync — a sanctioned repair, not a forbidden reconstruction — yet the oracle asserts 'never a third.' The happy-path clause is scoped to a 'well-formed first response' but the downgrade clause does not carry the equivalent 'well-formed first PROMPTED response' assumption.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria, AC-3 ('exactly two (native then prompted) on the 895c downgrade, never a third')
scenarios: 895c native->prompted downgrade where the first prompted reply fails deterministic parse/validation and the bounded in-Agent retry (N>=1) produces a valid second prompted reply — 3 total run_sync calls, all sanctioned
Any 895c-eligible model/contract run with structured_retry_limit unset (N=2) whose downgraded prompted output needs one repair
findings.suggested_fix: Restate AC-3 as: happy path = exactly one run_sync on a well-formed first response; 895c downgrade = exactly one native run_sync (which raises the grammar-rejection) followed by the prompted path's normal bounded budget (one run_sync on a well-formed first prompted reply, plus any sanctioned in-Agent output-repair retries up to N). Assert 'no additional OUTER run beyond the native attempt and the prompted bounded budget' — i.e. no bespoke fresh-Agent reconstruction — instead of a fixed count of two.
